whenToUse: Developer settings: API keys with scopes, traffic and expiry, plus webhook endpoints and delivery logs.
Creating keys with a show-once secret and revoking with typed confirmation.
avoidWhen: A full developer console app — use shell-10.
Role-based permissions for people — use permission-matrix.
a11y: Redelivery and copy feedback are announced via aria-live; create and revoke flows run in titled dialogs.
Never rely on colour alone for webhook health.
